name: jaml-language-support
description: Write JAML filters and run Balatro seed searches without leaving the editor.

chatParticipants.name: Jimbo
chatParticipants.description: Write a JAML filter. Every answer is checked against the Motely engine before you see it.

commands.name: filter
commands.description: Draft a JAML filter from a description, validated against the engine

commands.name: vocabulary
commands.description: List the real clause keys and value names the engine accepts

disambiguation.description: The user wants to write, fix, or understand a JAML filter for Balatro seed searching.
examples: find me a seed with Perkeo in ante 1
what's the key for planet cards

languageModelTools.name: jaml_validate
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Validate a JAML filter against the real Motely engine. Returns 'valid' or the engine's exact parse/validation error. ALWAYS call this before showing a user any JAML — the engine is the only authority on which clause keys and value names exist, and invented keys like 'planet:' or values like '*any*' are common and will be rejected.

jaml.description: The full JAML document text to validate.

jaml.cliPath.description: Path to the Motely CLI executable. Leave empty to use 'dotnet run --project Motely.CLI' from the workspace root.

jaml.threads.description: Threads to search with. 0 uses the CLI default.
